name: @tjakoen/grain-mcp
description: GRAIN-MCP — a zero-dependency, hand-rolled MCP stdio server over a grain app's STATIC EXPORT: reads the exported HTML, harvests the door manifest with grain's own pure domManifest, and serves read-only inspection + validation tools (grain_pages, grain_manifest, grain_actions, grain_validate_move) to any MCP client. No browser, no live driving, no npm dependencies beyond the grain workspace.
author: Tjakoen Stolk <tjakoen.s@gmail.com> (https://tjakoen.github.io)
